tasks.behavior: The complete money path is reviewed before phase 9, and its findings are fixed or queued (PLAN 8.12)
acceptance: PLAN 8.12: independent reviewers read invoice creation and the receive address (API, Go, pay page, canary), the watcher, finality, reorgs and the ledger, and the signer and settlement on all four enabled testnets; each finding is checked against the code and either fixed with a test in this task when small, or queued as its own task with severity; docs/reviews/money-path-2026-10.md records scope, findings, verdicts and the owner's live runs (Base Sepolia, Arc, Tempo); the backend and e2e checks pass
notes: 2026-10-11 review pass by subagent: All five fixes are correct; each test fails without its fix (reverted one at a time in a scratch copy: logs and wallet-logs split -> 'exceed max topics' in TestAddressListsAreSplitForTheNode; scan cap -> 'found in 1 scan' in TestLongBacklogIsCaughtUpOverSeveralScans; second-RPC check -> 'intent confirmed, invoice settlement settled' in TestSettlementIsBookedOnlyWhenTheSecondRPCAgrees; TempoMinGas -> 'one unit short: got <nil>' in TestCheckGasInFeeToken; the web 'another invoice' case can only pass with the id check). Re-ran after the comment pass: go test ./internal/watcher/ ./internal/settlement/ ok; vitest src/features/pay 12 passed; docs/runs/F121-20261011T145815Z-* all pass (e2e TestMoneyLoop runs the signer binary through NewRounds). Comment pass: the only code change is confirm() splitting the agreed check to log slog.Warn('settlement waits for the second RPC') before returning nil (reconcile.go:158-163), same behavior; the other edits are comments only, including migrations 00015-00017 (goose keeps no checksums). Safety reasons kept: D-15 on confirm, TempoMinGas source, the attodollar/6-decimal scale, the scan-cap and topic-limit reasons, the receive-address null rule. Checked: receive-address.ts:54 compares ids case-insensitively and the route validates the id; topicParts (watcher.go:250) never gets an empty list (callers guard), parts are disjoint, and wallet logs are deduplicated across parts by the shared seen map; the proxy rule refuses the unsplit 2-address lists. Scan cap (watcher.go:101): cursor uses headers[latest] when finalized>latest, rows above the cap are reorged only on a different hash, and expiry uses the scanned block's time. Every confirm() caller (reconcile.go:53/61/93, settle.go:79) leaves DB state unchanged on nil and retries; rounds.go:65,76 sets and deletes seconds with clients. TempoMinGas=2,262,000 matches live Tempo receipts (1,305,758/572,845 gas); at base fee 6e8 the floor is ~2,715 units ($0.0027). Base Sepolia pay hash in the record is a successful USDC transfer on chain. PROJECT.md D-15, architecture.md and money-safety.md match the code; F122-F125 match the record. Non-blocking: a detected row that never resolves would pin Scan at from+40,000 without an error (no current path found); scanLimit ignores span, so sustained overload at span 50 may exceed the 2-minute round; a disagreeing second RPC still gets no backoff or stored reason, only the log line; the UI-review items in the record are not queued.

tasks.behavior: A deposit the watcher missed, or money that reached a receive address without a transfer log, is found and held or alerted instead of leaving the invoice open
acceptance: R-20, D-27: when the second RPC's balance of a receive address is higher than what is booked (a log the RPC never returned, or Arc native USDC with no Transfer log), the worker rescans that address from the invoice's creation block, and money still unexplained is booked as payer_held and raises an operator alert, not only a log line; RescanDepth on chains whose finalized block equals latest (Arc, Tempo) covers at least 15 minutes; backend tests cover a missed log and an unlogged balance; money-safety.md matches the code

tasks.behavior: Watcher edge cases: deposits book in chain order, an empty balanceOf answer is an error, and a re-mined log under a final block alerts instead of failing the scan
acceptance: D-27: deposits of one invoice are booked in block and log order, never past an older detected one; ledger.BalanceAt treats an empty eth_call answer for an enabled token as an error; a unique-index conflict for one log alerts and skips that log so the chain's scan goes on; backend tests cover each

tasks.behavior: The signer recovers from stuck deploys, nonce gaps and stale gas limits, and checks its lock before each settlement
acceptance: R-22, R-30: a stuck deploy is replaced with a higher fee like a settle; a gap in the executor's nonces left by a settle that never went out is filled or reported to an operator; a replacement settle uses max(old gas limit, a fresh estimate × 1.2); the settle gas floor is per chain (Tempo about 600,000); the signer checks lock.Held before each intent; backend tests on Anvil cover each

tasks.behavior: The pay page and the canary check the terms and the page text, and the api checks the factory on every enabled chain at startup
acceptance: R-45, R-51, D-71: before showing an address the pay page refuses amount 0, a settle deadline other than expiry + 24 h, expiry over 365 days and a recipient equal to zero, the token, the factory or the implementation; the canary compares the network, token and amount shown on /pay/<id> with its own data and checks the terms' rules; the api refuses to start when the factory has no code on an enabled chain; unit and backend tests cover each
